item.title: ‼️ 🇮🇹 LUCIANO SPALLETTI TO ASSESS JEFF EKHATOR BEFORE SIGNING A NEW STRIKER IN…
item.description: ‼️ 🇮🇹 LUCIANO SPALLETTI TO ASSESS JEFF EKHATOR BEFORE SIGNING A NEW STRIKER IN JANUARY Luciano Spalletti will evaluate Jeff Ekhator over the coming weeks. The young striker will be given opportunities to demonstrate whether the profile Spalletti is looking for — a physically imposing centre-forward — is already available within the squad. Should the right opportunity arise on the transfer market under favourable conditions, the Bianconeri will remain attentive and look to satisfy the coach’s request for an attacking reinforcement. However, Juventus cannot make new signings without corresponding player departures. The club must carefully manage both squad registration requirements and Financial Fair Play (FFP) restrictions, two significant factors that cannot be overlooked when planning their January transfer business. ⚪️ ⚫️ 𝓢𝓸𝓾𝓻𝓬𝓮 — DiMarzio SkySport

item.description: ‼️ 🇮🇹 JEFF EKHATOR COULD LEAVE JUVENTUS ON LOAN IN JANUARY, WITH PARMA AND SASSUOLO AMONG THE INTERESTED CLUBS A potential departure for Juventus striker Jeff Ekhator during the January transfer window should not be ruled out. The young Italian forward could benefit from a loan move that would allow him to gain more consistent playing time and continue his development. A possible destination could be a club fighting to avoid relegation and looking to strengthen its attacking options. Parma and Sassuolo have already enquired about Ekhator’s availability, although they are not the only clubs interested in securing his services. 𝓢𝓸𝓾𝓻𝓬𝓮 — NicoSchira YouTube 𝓥𝓲𝓪 — Pueblo_Juve
